scope: Current official Mercado Livre routes for prelisting product identity and competitor price intelligence

confirmed.capability: Prelisting catalog-product discovery by product_identifier, query or part number, plus filters such as site, status and domain
confirmed.limitation: Returns catalog products, not the complete active-listing set

confirmed.capability: Catalog-product discovery using a domain and at least three public attributes
confirmed.limitation: Still returns catalog products rather than all seller offers

confirmed.capability: May expose buy_box_winner and buy_box_winner_price_range before the caller has a listing
confirmed.limitation: The fields can legitimately be null and have no published coverage SLA

confirmed.capability: Historically returned competing items with seller and price and still responded in the July 2026 project probe
confirmed.limitation: Official English documentation marks it for shutdown; Portuguese documentation still shows it. Treat as legacy observation, never a durable contract.
Requires an existing item and therefore does not solve prelisting discovery

confirmed.capability: Official documentation search and page retrieval
confirmed.limitation: Does not query catalog products, offers or prices

best_official_chain: products/search -> deterministic identity validation -> products/{id} -> consume winner/range only when non-null

project_live_evidence.conclusion: Official routes are the best identity layer but did not provide price coverage for the real cohort.
